# Data

Download the datasets from the [BCG Virtual Experience](https://www.theforage.com/simulations/bcg/data-science-ccdz) and place them here.

## Source files

| File | Rows | Columns | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `client_data.csv` | 14606 | 26 | Customer attributes, consumption, forecasts, churn label |
| `price_data.csv` | 193002 | 8 | Monthly price records per customer |

## Intermediate files (generated by notebooks)

| File | Generated by |
|------|-------------|
| `clean_data_after_eda.csv` | `notebooks/eda.ipynb` |
| `my_data_for_prediction.csv` | `notebooks/feature_engineering.ipynb` |
